column1: # Vowel contraction of a vowel-final stem syllable with the harmonic ending syllable (아/어/여 and 았/었/였).
# The final consonant of the ending syllable (ㅆ of 었) moves to the result.
#   stem    the stem syllable's vowel (jamo), or a whole syllable for a row that names one (a syllable
#           with a final consonant loses it when the row applies: 놓+아 → 놔)
#   result  the vowel of the merged syllable, or `-` to keep both syllables
#   mode    must: always (written and spoken); default: the standard short form, used unless
#           G runs in the uncontracted style; never: no contraction
#   cond    - | init=ㅇ (the stem syllable has no initial consonant: 오+아 → 와) | next=요 (요 follows) | prefinal (the honorific -시-, not a lexical 시)

column6: 놓+아 → 놔, 놓+았 → 놨 (the ㅎ drops; 놓아 stays standard)
